raw_response:
My reasoning:

I have been farming these 5.5 mu for 35 years now, and my hands know this soil. My husband and the children help sometimes but two of them work in town, so mostly it is me. With middle school, I can read the bag labels and I talk to the dealer in the village, but I mostly trust what has worked on my own land.

For the **winter wheat** (I plant about 2.5 mu to wheat and the rest to other uses, but actually I do the full rotation so all 5.5 mu — wheat in winter, maize in summer). I use improved wheat seed, usually Jimai variety — the dealer sells 矮抗58 or similar, about 15 kg seed per mu. Before planting in early October, I plough once with the tractor rental (about 40 yuan per mu), then rotary. As base fertilizer I spread one bag of compound 复合肥 (15-15-15), that is 50 kg per mu — so roughly 7.5 kg N, 7.5 kg P, 7.5 kg K. Then at jointing (拔节) in March I topdress with urea, one bag per 2 mu, so about 25 kg urea per mu which is another ~11-12 kg N. Total N around 19-20 kg/mu. I irrigate at planting (蒙头水), once before winter (冻水), once at jointing, and once at grain-filling — 4 times, because our well is good. I spray once for aphids and once mixed herbicide-fungicide at heading. Last year I got about 450 kg/mu, so I expect similar.

For the **summer maize** right after wheat harvest in June, I buy hybrid seed — Zhengdan 958 or Xianyu, the neighbor's field looked good with Denghai last year so maybe I try that. I do no-tillage, just plant directly into the wheat stubble with the seeder (免耕直播). Base fertilizer I put 40 kg compound 复合肥 (15-15-15) per mu at planting — so 6, 6, 6. Then at big-trumpet stage (大喇叭口) I topdress 30 kg urea per mu, about 14 kg N. Total N around 20 kg/mu. I irrigate once at planting if no rain and once more if August is dry — usually 2 times. I spray once for corn borer (玉米螟). Last year about 550 kg/mu.

I do not want to cut fertilizer — losing yield scares me more than spending a few hundred yuan extra on urea. But I also do not go crazy with it, one bag of compound and one bag of urea per mu is what most of us do around here.
